g.text: Annual turnover is the amounts ACTUALLY PAID
on fully paid invoices in the year ending on 31 December.
Do not use gross order values or unpaid invoices.
Store this rate for the next calendar year (AD28).
Store calendarYear = nextYear and percentage = computed rate
Reject new orders until the full outstanding balance is paid.

Subtract 10% of the amount AFTER the order discount.
The acquisition offer and ordinary first-order allowance
are the SAME single 10% one-time discount (invoice field).
oneTimeDiscountGranted = true means eligible, not consumed;
